posts.text:
An honor to be in this fight alongside you, @LaurenUnderwood.


Lauren Underwood (@LaurenUnderwood)

With their gutting of the Voting Rights Act, SCOTUS is ushering in a new confederacy. 

First they strike down the voting rights amendment, then they strike down legally drawn democratic maps.

Power belongs in the hands of the voters — not unelected elites. From me and @aoc:

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/LaurenUnderwood/status/2054988382091006228#m

A triumphant accomplishment and a demonstration of what we can accomplish together.

Thank you @GovKathyHochul, @AndreaSCousins, and @CarlHeastieNY for rising to the moment and to the visionary leadership of @NYCMayor who never gave up on a city that works for all New Yorkers.


Mayor Zohran Kwame Mamdani (@NYCMayor)

When we came into office, we uncovered a $12 billion budget deficit.

Today, I’m proud to say we brought it down to zero.

We didn’t close the gap on the backs of working people.

Thank you, @ReverendWarnock, for welcoming me to Ebenezer Baptist Church today.

As legislatures across the South seek to draw Black Americans out of power, we gathered this Sunday to steel ourselves for the work ahead.

We will always stand together, and we will not go back.

Video

Helloooo, Georgia! 🍑 🗳️ 

I am so proud to endorse and support the incredible @ruwaromman for Georgia State Senate, SD7.

Early voting has already started. The time is NOW to get out the vote and help elect this incredible leader! ruwaforgeorgia.com



Ruwa Romman (@ruwaromman)

Election Day is May 19th! We’re building a movement for a Georgia we can afford and where we belong. I’m ecstatic to have the support of @AOC in this fight. 

It’s why I’m running for Senate District 7. Together we can:
